study: CW08 persistent-player-skill and quote-eligible shadow v3
freshStatus: Outcomes not previously collected or scored by CW08; fetch only after committing the fitted artifacts and protocol
historicalQuoteStatus: All 317 archived quote rows, including abstentions; retrospective diagnostic, not untouched validation because some original pick outcomes were previously inspected
features: Existing ten same-season/team opportunity features plus logit of Beta-20 shrunk prior-60-game any-event rate, log of Gamma prior-20-games count/minute rate, current prior-three-game minutes times shrunk count/minute rate, log1p prior games. Persistent skill may cross seasons/teams; current role never inherits another team's minutes.
candidates: long-history hurdle with global intercept calibration
long-history hurdle with fixed prior-minute bands <12 / 12-18 / >=18 intercept calibration
eventFit: Standardize fitting inputs only; logistic L2 C=1; fixed max_iter=500
positiveFit: Zero-truncated Poisson likelihood, standardized fitting inputs only, L2 strength 1; positive-count factor calibrated on calibration rows only
selection: Choose global versus role-conditioned candidate on calibration Brier only, before fetching new evaluation outcomes. No hyperparameter search. No use of test outcomes or future quote eligibility in fitting.
pricing: Exact count masses, normalized probabilities, integer pushes, two-sided American-price EV, >=3% EV with no 55% win floor and no direction quota
release: Never auto-promote. Require actual fixture/quote-eligible fresh pregame evidence and nonregression versus frozen baselines, original and broad cohorts, adequate fixture uncertainty, prospective finalized shadow outcomes, history preservation and application regressions.
scope: NHL goals and assists research/shadow only. No production route, scheduler, database write, original pick overwrite, dashboard rebuild or deployment.
